## Design

### 2026-10-24 – I followed the tutorial for the schematic but made the rotary encoder switch's switch work and added 1 more led and removed 1 bourns slider. I wanted just to folllow the tutorial rlly close. But again

**4.55h**

I followed the tutorial for the schematic but made the rotary encoder switch's switch work and added 1 more led and removed 1 bourns slider. I wanted just to folllow the tutorial rlly close. But again i wanted to my own design, so i started experimenting with tiling different shapes into something that looks cool and can maybe function similar to a keyboard. I ended up with this hexagonal angular design:

  ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/AFZopaMKFyHCDshxv5dukDrK6iIzAB4Y/c8533a22763a4c201c2e5f001eb5860f513758c375b216202ee0fcb4b74cde89.png)

  It took a lot of time to translate that design to the footprint editor because I wasn't experienced whatsoever and gemini was acting stupid. So now I'm pretty much done with the pcb. Heres what it looks like now:

  ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/AFZopaMKFyHCDshxv5dukDrK6iIzAB4Y/4b68cc5b25e060221b23dc028da222348fe2cd8b9a3641c94beaa2fc13b2c971.png)

### 2026-10-25 – alr final journal, I made the BOM and made some changes to the pcb. Noteably I changed the bourns slide potentiometer from the PTA1543 to the PTA2043 cuz i CANT find a PTA1543 potentiometer under $10.

**3.57h**

alr final journal, I made the BOM and made some changes to the pcb. Noteably I changed the bourns slide potentiometer from the PTA1543 to the PTA2043 cuz i CANT find a PTA1543 potentiometer under $10. I also realized i had the esp 32 the wrong way around lol. Had to rewire a LOT of stuff. Also made a chasis in fusion real quick.
